glosses: S'adresser à (quelqu'un) de manière peu amicale, reprimander.

examples.text: Nach dem Fehlpass raunzte ihn sein Mitspieler an.
The teacher angrily bawled out my name.

glosses: To deliver a loud, hard scolding or lecture to; to reprimand in order to kill.

examples.text: After a mistake like that, there wasn't much to do besides bawl out the offender and clean up.

glosses: To have a serious argument accompanied by shouting.
